workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Attach or detach workload instance

properties.description: Resolves one exact workload instance, then fails closed with 422 before Attach or Detach. The public schema defines Action values and Attaching or Detaching transitions but no authoritative Attached or Detached terminal relationship proof, so this export performs no PATCH. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read organizations, deployments, and instances. Names are OData-escaped, relationships are scoped by Moid, and every primary lookup must return exactly one identity-preserving result. Detach still requires explicit confirmation, but confirmation cannot bypass the behavior gate. No wait setting can turn the gate into success. Generic API reads are necessary because no supported purpose-built exact resolver is available; replace them when one becomes available. Revisit only after live-tenant and schema evidence establish a safe terminal contract.
properties.display_name: Cisco Intersight - Attach or detach workload instance

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation did not complete"
errorMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganization = ""
escapedDeployment = ""
escapedInstance = ""
requestedAction = ""
waitForCompletion = False
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0
requestBody = "{}"

def as_bool(value):
    normalized = str(value).strip().lower()
    if normalized in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
        return True
    if normalized in {"false", "0", "no"}:
        return False
    raise ValueError("A boolean input was not serialized as true or false.")

try:
    organization = sys.argv[1].strip()
    deployment = sys.argv[2].strip()
    instance = sys.argv[3].strip()
    actionInput = sys.argv[4].strip()
    waitForCompletion = as_bool(sys.argv[5])
    waitTimeoutSeconds = int(sys.argv[6])
    confirmation = as_bool(sys.argv[7])
    mode = sys.argv[8]
    if not organization or not deployment or not instance:
        raise ValueError("Workload Organization, Workload Deployment Name, and Workload Instance Name must each be non-empty.")
    allowed = {
        "deploy-retry": {"Deploy", "Retry"},
        "suspend-resume": {"Suspend", "Resume"},
        "attach-detach": {"Attach", "Detach"},
        "unassign": {"UnAssign"},
    }
    if mode not in allowed or actionInput not in allowed[mode]:
        raise ValueError("Action does not exactly match an allowed API action for this workflow.")
    if mode == "attach-detach" and actionInput == "Detach" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Detach must be true before Detach can be evaluated.")
    if mode == "unassign" and not confirmation:
        raise ValueError("Confirm Unassign must be true before UnAssign can be evaluated.")
    if waitForCompletion and (waitTimeoutSeconds < 1 or waitTimeoutSeconds > 1800):
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds must be from 1 through 1800 when waiting is enabled.")
    if not waitForCompletion and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        raise ValueError("Wait Timeout Seconds cannot be negative.")
    escapedOrganization = organization.replace("'", "''")
    escapedDeployment = deployment.replace("'", "''")
    escapedInstance = instance.replace("'", "''")
    requestedAction = actionInput
    requestBody = json.dumps({"Action":requestedAction}, separators=(",", ":"))
    status = "ok"
    statusCode = "200"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle inputs validated and OData literals escaped"
    errorMessage = ""
    resultJson = json.dumps({"inputValidation":"passed","requestedAction":requestedAction,"waitForCompletion":waitForCompletion}, separators=(",", ":"))
except ValueError as exc:
    status = "invalid"
    statusCode = "400"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input validation failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Lifecycle input preparation helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Lifecycle input preparation helper failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Organization lookup inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""

try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    results = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "404"
        statusMessage = "No exact organization match was found"
        errorMessage = "The organization lookup returned zero matches; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":0}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "409"
        statusMessage = "Organization lookup is ambiguous"
        errorMessage = "The organization lookup returned more than one match; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        moid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid:
            status = "invalid"
            statusCode = "502"
            statusMessage = "Organization identity validation failed"
            errorMessage = "The sole organization result did not preserve the exact requested Name, concrete ObjectType, and non-empty Moid."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            status = "ok"
            statusCode = "200"
            statusMessage = "Exact organization resolved"
            errorMessage = ""
            resultJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Organization lookup inspection helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Organization lookup inspection failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "helper-failure"
statusCode = "500"
statusMessage = "Workload instance inspection did not complete"
errorMessage = "Workload instance inspection failed."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
instanceMoid = ""
modTime = ""
preStatus = ""
preLastAction = ""
assignedResourceCount = 0
instanceJson = "{}"
requestedAction = ""

try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    expectedOrganization = sys.argv[3]
    expectedDeployment = sys.argv[4]
    requestedAction = sys.argv[5]
    mode = sys.argv[6]
    results = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The workload-instance response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "404"
        statusMessage = "No exact workload instance match was found"
        errorMessage = "The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned zero matches; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":0}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        status = "invalid"
        statusCode = "409"
        statusMessage = "Workload instance lookup is ambiguous"
        errorMessage = "The fully scoped workload-instance lookup returned more than one match; exactly one is required."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage,"matchCount":len(results)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        organization = item.get("Organization") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        deployment = item.get("WorkloadDeployment") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        instanceMoid = item.get("Moid") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        modTime = item.get("ModTime") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        preStatus = item.get("Status") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        preLastAction = item.get("LastAction") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
        assigned = item.get("AssignedResources") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if assigned is None:
            assigned = []
        validIdentity = (
            isinstance(item, dict)
            and item.get("Name") == expectedName
            and item.get("ObjectType") == "workload.WorkloadInstance"
            and isinstance(instanceMoid, str) and bool(instanceMoid)
            and isinstance(modTime, str) and bool(modTime)
            and isinstance(preStatus, str) and bool(preStatus)
            and isinstance(organization, dict) and organization.get("Moid") == expectedOrganization
            and isinstance(deployment, dict) and deployment.get("Moid") == expectedDeployment
            and isinstance(assigned, list)
        )
        if not validIdentity:
            status = "invalid"
            statusCode = "502"
            statusMessage = "Workload instance identity validation failed"
            errorMessage = "The sole result did not preserve exact Name, Organization.Moid, WorkloadDeployment.Moid, ObjectType, Moid, ModTime, Status, and AssignedResources shape."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            assignedResourceCount = len(assigned)
            instanceJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":"))
            busy = {"InProgress", "UnAssigning", "Detaching", "Attaching"}
            if preStatus in busy:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "A conflicting workload-instance transition is active"
                errorMessage = "The selected instance is in %s; wait for that transition to finish before issuing %s." % (preStatus, requestedAction)
            elif mode == "attach-detach":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "422"
                statusMessage = "Attach or Detach requires live-tenant validation"
                errorMessage = "The public schema exposes Attach, Detach, Attaching, and Detaching but no authoritative attached or detached terminal state or relationship proof. This workflow therefore fails closed before mutation."
            elif mode == "suspend-resume" and requestedAction == "Resume":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "422"
                statusMessage = "Resume requires live-tenant validation"
                errorMessage = "The public schema does not define an authoritative terminal state for Resume. This branch fails closed before mutation instead of assuming that Ok always proves completion."
            elif mode == "suspend-resume" and requestedAction == "Suspend" and preStatus != "Ok":
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively suspendable"
                errorMessage = "Suspend is permitted only from Status=Ok until additional tenant transition evidence is captured."
            elif mode == "deploy-retry" and requestedAction == "Deploy" and preStatus not in {"Staging", "ReadyToDeploy", "ChangesScheduled"}:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively deployable"
                errorMessage = "Deploy is permitted only from Staging, ReadyToDeploy, or ChangesScheduled."
            elif mode == "deploy-retry" and requestedAction == "Retry" and preStatus not in {"Failed", "ChangesScheduled", "InSufficientResource", "OutOfService"}:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Current state is not conservatively retryable"
                errorMessage = "Retry is permitted only from Failed, ChangesScheduled, InSufficientResource, or OutOfService."
            elif mode == "unassign" and assignedResourceCount == 0:
                status = "invalid"
                statusCode = "409"
                statusMessage = "Workload instance has no assigned resources"
                errorMessage = "UnAssign is rejected because AssignedResources is already empty; no release action is required."
            else:
                status = "ok"
                statusCode = "200"
                statusMessage = "Exact workload instance and lifecycle preconditions validated"
                errorMessage = ""
            resultJson = json.dumps({
                "Moid":instanceMoid,
                "Name":expectedName,
                "Status":preStatus,
                "LastAction":preLastAction,
                "ModTime":modTime,
                "AssignedResourceCount":assignedResourceCount,
                "requestedAction":requestedAction,
                "validationStatus":status
            }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    status = "helper-failure"
    statusCode = "500"
    statusMessage = "Workload instance inspection helper failed"
    errorMessage = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Workload instance inspection failed","detail":errorMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
